meta_description:
12K likes, 29 comments - casarthakahuja on April 27, 2026: "This week, I sat down with Eugenio Ferrante to unpack how global entity structuring is changing in 2026...

We look at what kind of businesses are best suited to be incorporated in Singapore, in Hong Kong, in Dubai, and in the UK...

How tax and compliance change across these regions for entrepreneurs operating from India... 

And how one can build their international corporate structures for global business expansion.

Check out the full episode on Founder’s Office with Sarthak Ahuja on YouTube, as well as on Spotify.

Produced and Directed by Aditi Randev for Niamh Originals.

https://youtu.be/VW3O-JeR_GA?si=i0Q2n_2G6h8y04Ah

#casarthakahuja #aditirandev".
